selection_reason.thepaper-sidebar: domestic society and public-issue bodies; mixed byline fixed, no-text media failures retained
selection_reason.36kr-newsflashes: incremental AI/technology business briefs, never first-party technical coverage

not_selected.netease-home: current sampled headlines largely official reprints and overlap; lower marginal contribution
not_selected.tencent-headlines: all six titles overlap NetEase; first two material families duplicate the NetEase reports

target_environment.equivalence: same production Linux image and network; only public_sources.py and sources.yml bind-mounted read-only from the registered revision; app services untouched

window.sampling: rotate by round index, retaining first and subsequent appearances without forcing updates
window.missed_rounds: retain scheduled timestamps and failures; do not compress catch-up requests or silently restart the window

sampling_scope: scan quota 30 matches proposed runtime bounds; rotate all returned forms, retain media/unknown/none failures in denominator; no text-only filtering
restart_policy: no automatic restart; preserve failure/missed schedule, new version for a new extractor/window; never replace prior output
